complete_statement: For every natural n >= the explicit threshold, there is a proper linear 3-CNF on n ambient original Boolean variables with exactly 12n clauses, maximum occurrence 4096, strict half-boundary expansion up to floor(n/10^16), and an UNSAT signing. Every sound original-variable F2 affine-clause source DAG from its raw clause/Boolean axioms, with raw input width at most 3 and an empty finish, has both node count and distinct nonempty false-flat count above rank floor(floor(n/10^16)/16) at least (1/4) exp(n/(81*2^65*10^32)).

family_existence_proof.deletion: At most 2n high-degree triples and at most n conflicting endpoints; retain exactly 12n triples.
family_existence_proof.expansion_failure_mass_upper_bound: 1/4, using finite witness counting and a geometric sum from t=3.
family_existence_proof.sample_space: Bernoulli subsets of the finite subtype of proper distinct triples, with rho=96/n^2.
family_existence_proof.simultaneous_sample: Average of two failure indicators plus degreeSquares/(8192n) plus orderedPairs/n is <=339/512<1.
family_existence_proof.unsat_signing: At most 2^n*7^(12n) of 8^(12n) local signings are covered by satisfying assignments; the inequality is strict.

proof_system_hypotheses: F2 affine-clause rows on the original Fin n variable type.
Raw input falsity polynomials belong to the signed clause/explicit Boolean axiom set, and initial row width is at most 3.
Each derived step is a semantically sound consequence of one or two strictly earlier rows; arbitrary parent reuse is permitted.
Some designated row is the empty clause.

python_reproduction.scope: Finite tests and deterministic report reproduction, separate from the Lean proof and axiom audit.

scope_limits: The theorem concerns the stated original-variable F2 proof system, not all SAT algorithms or arbitrary extensions.
The formal family is existential; no efficient generator is claimed.
Other-field and arbitrary-parent-arity paper generalizations are outside this completion statement.
No external specialist review, historical-priority claim or P versus NP conclusion is supplied.
Local Lean package compilation and transitive axiom audit, not a new hosted CI run or an independent kernel replay of every cached Mathlib object.
